contact.note: ASSUMED as in the IKV trace: blade/skate-puck collisions keep half the approach speed (frictionless); boards and posts inelastic.

fitted.method: two stages (scripts/edwall-trace.py --fit pass|shot), each a differential-evolution search inside fit.bounds and a Nelder-Mead polish: pass = the passer's rest rotation, lunge and turn against the puck readings (streak weight 0.15) and the slide-rule limits; shot = the shooter's lunge and turns against the goal window, the goal-line target and the slide-rule limits

rw_return.note: after the pass the right wing goes back to the pose the cleaned track reads just after the goal (model readings), in a designed smootherstep move

limitations: PROPOSED rebuild from one broadcast camera; nothing is measured on the table.

Puck: the synthetic detector's track (data/games/nm26-semifinal/g2/puck-track-synth.json, PROPOSED, x/y = puck centre) where it has a detection, the hand readings (shots/edwall/puck-readings.json, z = 6 mm) elsewhere; low-score detections weigh less. The rest position is the mean of the detector's slow detections before the play (about 44 mm off the board; v1 snapped it to the board).

Right wing (passer) and centre (shooter): the lunges and turns are DESIGNED smootherstep moves fitted to the puck observations, the goal and the figures' own tracker v3 readings (src 0) inside the moves.

Both plays are modelled as heel-groove carries: the puck stays at the touching point of the figure from catch to release and leaves with that point's velocity (NTHF: 'carries the puck with the heel groove'). The fit penalises carries whose needed force lies outside the contact-normal fan (carry_force_check); the preview figure has no modelled groove.

The centre's shovel and the goal are hidden in the broadcast (behind the E goalie and the near goal frame): the shot is DESIGNED to score into the open far (+y) corner; its exact contact and line are not observed.
The other ten figures follow tracker v3 (data/games/nm26-semifinal/g2/figure-tracks-v3.json, PROPOSED, not verified frame by frame).
Ice friction 926.1 mm/s^2 is borrowed from the spjass slide fit; figure restitution 0.5 frictionless; puck thickness 12 mm assumed.

observations.note: PROPOSED detector track (docs/synthetic-puck.md); x/y = puck centre. Detections replace the hand readings on the same frames; scores under full_weight_score weigh weight_low_score. Frames after obs_to_frame are left out (the detector jumps elsewhere once the puck is hidden).

figure_constraints.note: tracker v3 readings (src 0) of the passer and the shooter inside their moves (docs/tracker-v3.md: rotation median error about 8 deg on the label crops; inside fast moves less certain, hence the wider sigma and the cap). ASSUMED weights.
figure_constraints.note_shot: v2 refit: the shooter is held to the tracker only until it reaches the front of its slot (wc_front_frame); with the release swing also held, no fitted shot scored (the goalie blocked it), so the swing itself is left to the goal target. ASSUMED.
